clauses.text:
Owner decisions 2026-10-26 (E:/Projects/Personal/MekStation-wt/_receipts/owner-decisions-20261026.md, sha256 1bff42f7ff8c6d91686bda5a6ac8f396ac21e2f5d9d57348a4865d72afb872bc) items 1 and 2, verbatim (the owner answered: "then yes, lets go and fix the 2 bugs and other recommendations as we're going through"):
1. Register MISSION-MATCH-1 as one release-blocking unit in Step 3, right after L1-SMOKE-A2F closes and before A2M. It fixes two co-op mission match defects:
   a. Spectate lockout: the first POST /api/multiplayer/matches/:id/spectate on a seat-less co-op mission match switches membership from roster mode to seat mode and locks out the GM and players (confirmed by a scratch test through the real routes against SQLite; report _reports/2026-10-26/spectate-roster-probe/). Fix: MatchSeatMembershipSource.lookupMembership keeps roster mode when the match has no seats or only spectator seats; a rostered player asking to spectate its own seat-less match gets 409. S5-02 (the spectate door checks no membership) stays open.
   b. Sealed-declaration owner: MatchWireSealedChoices treats the first sideAssignments entry for a side as its only owner, so with two players on one side the other player's own Move/Attack/Physical declarations are withheld from it until the reveal and shown live to the first-listed teammate (source reading; report _reports/2026-10-26/stale-owner-reachability.md). Fix: one owning function sideOfPlayer(assignments, playerId); sealed delivery uses it. Policy: teammates on a side see each other's sealed declarations live.
2. Step 3 prBudget 10 -> 12. Step 4 stays 29. If A2 must split, Root returns to the owner (Step 3 would need 14).

Registered blocked by commit ff5d09ee0 of this PR: node R2.authority-live, ownershipPaths src/lib/multiplayer/server (an existing roadmap literal), ten registeredSourceLeaves, reviewClasses authority and privacy, acceptance MM1-MM7; Step 3 prBudget 10 -> 12 (v220-steps.json and its pinned test); closures 54 -> 55. units.json ownerRuling20261026MissionMatch quotes AUTH-1 with the same sha256.

GATE OPEN for this admission is conditional on this PR merging (the Root brief to the implementation worker of this PR names the registration as commit 2 and this admission as commit 3, the #2336 and #2339 riding pattern).

OWNER-RULING 2815c144f (comment 6427223735; Root copy sha256 3a038d324d9e0bf01bf43e6e578d7fa3019e8c3d47ceec480821ee5db4fe5541), verbatim:
